fields.name: id
decorators: @UuidField({ primaryKey: true, generated: true, required: true })

fields.name: street
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, maxLength: 200, docs: "Street address (including number, apartment, etc.)" })

fields.name: city
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, maxLength: 100, docs: "City or locality" })

fields.name: state
decorators: @TextField({ maxLength: 100, docs: "State, province, or region" })

fields.name: postalCode
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, maxLength: 20, docs: "Postal or ZIP code" })

fields.name: country
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, maxLength: 100, docs: "Country" })

fields.name: id
decorators: @UuidField({ required: true, primaryKey: true, generated: true, docs: "Unique identifier for the budget" })

fields.name: name
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, minLength: 3, maxLength: 200, docs: "Budget name or description" })

fields.name: hourlyRate
decorators: @DecimalField({ required: true, decimals: 2, roundingType: "roundHalfToEven", min: "0", docs: "Hourly labor rate" })

fields.name: estimatedHours
decorators: @NumberField({ required: true, min: 0, docs: "Estimated hours for the project" })

fields.name: materialsCost
decorators: @DecimalField({ required: true, decimals: 2, roundingType: "roundHalfToEven", min: "0", docs: "Cost of materials" })

fields.name: taxRate
decorators: @DecimalField({ required: true, decimals: 2, roundingType: "roundHalfToEven", min: "0", max: "100", docs: "Tax rate as a percentage" })

fields.name: laborCost
decorators: @DecimalField({ required: false, calculation: "manual", decimals: 2, roundingType: "roundHalfToEven", docs: "Total labor cost (hourlyRate * estimatedHours)" })

fields.name: subtotal
decorators: @DecimalField({ required: false, calculation: "manual", decimals: 2, roundingType: "roundHalfToEven", docs: "Subtotal before tax (laborCost + materialsCost)" })

fields.name: taxAmount
decorators: @DecimalField({ required: false, calculation: "manual", decimals: 2, roundingType: "roundHalfToEven", docs: "Tax amount calculated on subtotal" })

fields.name: total
decorators: @DecimalField({ required: false, calculation: "manual", decimals: 2, roundingType: "roundHalfToEven", docs: "Total cost including tax" })

fields.name: effectiveTaxRate
decorators: @DecimalField({ required: false, calculation: "manual", decimals: 2, roundingType: "roundHalfToEven", docs: "Effective tax rate as percentage of total" })

fields.name: summary
decorators: @TextField({ required: false, calculation: "manual", docs: "Summary of the budget breakdown" })

fields.name: description
decorators: @TextField({ docs: "Optional description of the file" })

fields.name: id
decorators: @UuidField({ required: true, primaryKey: true, generated: true, docs: "Unique identifier for the report" })

fields.name: title
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, docs: "Title of the report" })

fields.name: generatedAt
decorators: @DateTimeField({ required: true, docs: "Date and time when the report was generated" })

fields.name: project
decorators: @ReferenceField({ required: false, type: () => Project, docs: "The project this report belongs to" })

fields.name: file
decorators: @ReferenceField({ required: true, type: () => File, docs: "The associated PDF file" })

fields.name: sections
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, docs: "Sections included in the report" })

fields.name: id
decorators: @UuidField({ required: true, primaryKey: true, generated: true, docs: "Unique identifier for the task" })

fields.name: title
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, minLength: 3, maxLength: 200, docs: "Title of the task" })

fields.name: description
decorators: @LongTextField({ maxLength: 5000, docs: "Detailed description of the task" })

fields.name: status
decorators: @ChoiceField({ required: true, type: () => TaskStatus, docs: "Current status of the task" })
@Index({ type: "hash", name: "idx_task_status" })

fields.name: priority
decorators: @ChoiceField({ required: true, type: () => TaskPriority, docs: "Priority level of the task", query: {"sorting":false} })
@Index({ type: "hash", name: "idx_task_priority" })

fields.name: project
assignee
reporter
estimatedHours
decorators: @IntegerField({ min: 0, max: 999, docs: "Estimated hours to complete the task" })

fields.name: actualHours
decorators: @IntegerField({ min: 0, max: 999, docs: "Actual hours spent on the task" })

fields.name: dueDate
decorators: @DateField({ docs: "Due date for the task" })
@Index()

fields.name: startedAt
decorators:
@DateField({ docs: "When the task was started", available: (task: Task) => task.status === TaskStatus.InProgress ||
      task.status === TaskStatus.InReview ||
      task.status === TaskStatus.Done ||
      task.status === TaskStatus.Blocked })

fields.name: completedAt
decorators: @DateField({ docs: "When the task was completed", available: (task: Task) => task.status === TaskStatus.Done })

fields.name: isBillable
decorators: @BooleanField({ docs: "Whether the task is billable to the client", required: true })

fields.name: tags
decorators: @TextField({ docs: "Tags for categorizing the task" })

fields.name: createdAt
decorators: @DateTimeField({ docs: "When the task was created" })

fields.name: updatedAt
decorators: @DateTimeField({ docs: "When the task was last updated" })

fields.name: technicalDetails
decorators: @LongTextField({ docs: "Technical details, reproduction steps, or code snippets" })

fields.name: jsonMetadata
decorators: @JsonField({ docs: "Custom metadata for the task (e.g. external IDs, integration data, custom attributes)" })

fields.name: reviewChecks
decorators: @CompositionField({ type: () => ReviewChecks, required: false })

fields.name: notes
decorators: @CompositionField({ type: () => Note, docs: "Notes associated with the task" })

fields.name: metadata
decorators: @CompositionField({ type: () => TaskMetadata, docs: "Key/value metadata entries for the task" })

fields.name: attachments
decorators: @ReferenceField({ type: () => File, docs: "File attachments for this task (images, PDFs, documents, etc.)" })

fields.name: summary
decorators: @TextField({ minLength: 3, maxLength: 200, calculation: "manual" })

fields.name: id
decorators: @UuidField({ primaryKey: true, generated: true, required: true, docs: "Unique identifier for the user" })

fields.name: createdAt
decorators: @DateTimeField({ docs: "When the user account was created" })

fields.name: updatedAt
decorators: @DateTimeField({ docs: "When the user account was last updated" })

fields.name: roles
decorators: @ChoiceField({ type: () => Role, docs: "Roles assigned to the user" })

fields.name: addresses
decorators: @SharedCompositionField({ type: () => Address })

fields.name: firstName
decorators: @TextField()

fields.name: lastName
decorators: @TextField()

fields.name: email
decorators: @EmailField()

fields.name: password
decorators: @TextField()

decorators: @ChoiceField()

fields.name: id
decorators: @UuidField({ required: true, primaryKey: true, generated: true, docs: "Unique identifier for the project" })

fields.name: name
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, minLength: 3, maxLength: 100, docs: "Name of the project" })

fields.name: code
decorators: @TextField({ required: true, minLength: 3, maxLength: 20, regex: "/^[A-Z]{2,5}-\d{1,5}$/", regexMessage: "Code must be in format: PREFIX-NUMBER (e.g., PROJ-123)", docs: "Unique project code identifier" })

fields.name: description
decorators: @HtmlField({ maxLength: 5000, docs: "Detailed description of the project" })

fields.name: status
decorators: @ChoiceField({ required: true, type: () => ProjectStatus, docs: "Current status of the project" })

fields.name: priority
decorators: @ChoiceField({ required: true, type: () => ProjectPriority, docs: "Priority level of the project" })

fields.name: startDate
decorators: @DateField({ docs: "Project start date" })

fields.name: endDate
decorators: @DateField({ docs: "Project end date" })

fields.name: budget
decorators: @MoneyField({ decimals: 2, roundingType: "roundHalfToEven", min: "0", positive: true, docs: "Total budget allocated for the project" })

fields.name: completionPercentage
decorators: @IntegerField({ min: 0, max: 100, docs: "Project completion percentage (0-100)" })

fields.name: meetingTime
decorators: @TimeField({ min: "08:00", max: "17:00", precision: "HH:mm", docs: "Daily meeting time for the project team" })

fields.name: manager
decorators: @ReferenceField({ required: true, type: () => User, load: true, docs: "Project manager responsible for this project" })

fields.name: teamMembers
decorators: @ReferenceField({ type: () => User, load: true, docs: "Team members assigned to this project" })

fields.name: isArchived
decorators: @BooleanField({ docs: "Whether the project is archived", required: true })

fields.name: createdAt
decorators: @DateTimeField({ docs: "When the project was created" })

fields.name: updatedAt
decorators: @DateTimeField({ docs: "When the project was last updated" })

fields.name: support
decorators: @CompositionField({ type: () => Support, docs: "Support details associated with the project" })

fields.name: summary
decorators: @TextField({ minLength: 3, maxLength: 200, calculation: "automatic" })
